result.topic_en: Elasticity calculations: displacement fields (u, v, w) produced by point forces and couples in an isotropic elastic body with Lamé constants λ, μ, expressed through derivatives of the distance ρ and of r, together with a reciprocity relation and an attempt to determine an auxiliary function V_1.
result.transcription:
$\rho^2=(x-\xi)^2+(y-\eta)^2+(z-\zeta)^2$ [-...-] $x^2+y^2+z^2=r$ [?]  III
$\int X\varrho\varrho\,d\varpi=A\quad\int Y\varrho\varrho\,d\varpi=0\quad\int Z\varrho\varrho\,d\varpi=0,\quad\int(yZ-zY)\varrho\varrho\,d\varpi=0\quad\int(zX-xZ)\varrho\varrho\,d\varpi=\zeta A\quad\int(xY-yX)\varrho\varrho\,d\varpi=-\eta A$
[-$\int(yX-xY)\varrho\varrho\,d\varpi=\eta A$-]
$\int X\,rr\,d\varpi=-A\quad\int(zX-xZ)\,rr\,d\varpi=\zeta A\quad\int(xY-yX)\,rr\,d\varpi=+\eta A$
1) $(\xi,\eta,\zeta)$
$u=\frac{A}{8\pi\mu(\lambda+2\mu)}\left((\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x^2}-2(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{1}{\varrho}\right)$
$v=\quad\cdot\quad(\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x\partial y}$
$w=\quad\cdot\quad(\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x\partial z}$
2) $(0,0,0)$
$u=\frac{A}{8\pi\mu(\lambda+2\mu)}\left[-(\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2 r}{\partial x^2}+(\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{1}{r}[?]-\eta\frac{\partial\frac{1}{r}}{\partial y}-\zeta\frac{\partial\frac{1}{r}}{\partial z}\right)\right]$
$v=\quad -(\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2 r}{\partial x\partial y}+(\lambda+2\mu)\,\eta\,\frac{\partial\frac{1}{r}}{\partial x}$
$w=\quad -(\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2 r}{\partial x\partial z}+(\lambda+2\mu)\,\zeta\,\frac{\partial\frac{1}{r}}{\partial x}$
3) in der Begrenzung [?] $X=0,\ Y=0,\ Z=0.$
$\Sigma\varpi\left((Xu'+Yv'+Zw')-(X'u+Y'v+Z'w)\right)=0\qquad\Sigma\varpi(X'u'+Y'v'+Z'w')=uA-u_0A+\frac12 A\eta\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x_0}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial y_0}\right)$
$+\frac12 A\zeta\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial x_0}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial z_0}\right)$
$(x=0)\ V_1=0,\ \zeta_3=0,\ \zeta_2=0$
$x\left(\int_0^x\Delta^2V_1\,dx+\varphi(y,z)\right)-2V_1=\varphi\quad\Delta^2\varphi\left[\left(\frac{\Delta^2V_1}{\partial x}\right)_0+\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial z^2}\right]x,\quad\left(\frac{\Delta^2V_1}{\partial x}\right)_0+\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial z^2}=0$
$-2\left(\frac{\partial^2V_1}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2V_1}{\partial z^2}\right)+x\frac{\partial\Delta^2V_1}{\partial x}$
$2\left(\frac{\partial^2V_1}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2V_1}{\partial z^2}\right)+x\frac{\Delta^2\partial V_1}{\partial x}=$
$\frac{x}{\mu}\int_0^x\Delta^2V_1\,dx=4(\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x^2}\,x$
$\frac{2}{\mu}V_1=4(\lambda+\mu)(x-\xi)\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x^2}-4(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x}$

methods.what: Force and moment conditions (resultant A in x-direction at point (ξ,η,ζ)) defining a point load
Kelvin-type fundamental solution for a point force in an isotropic elastic medium
Displacement field for force plus couples at the origin
Betti reciprocity theorem for two load systems with traction-free boundary
Determination of auxiliary function V_1 for half-space boundary x=0
